moat_type: Process Leadership in High-Performance Computing and Graphics Processing Units (GPUs)
primary_risk: Dependence on a few large customers and potential disruption from new entrants
sector_survival_note: The semiconductor industry is highly competitive and subject to rapid technological change, which may lead to disruption and replacement of market leaders.
thesis_summary: AMD's high-performance computing and GPU products ride the trend of increasing demand for computing power and artificial intelligence.
thesis_breaks_if: The 8-K/news items do not represent a structural change to the 10-15yr thesis, but rather short-term noise to ignore.
sentiment_note: The company is richly valued, but its history and durability suggest a long-term hold.

The company's gross margin has been stable over the past 8 years, with a 53% gross margin.
The company's return on invested capital (ROIC) has been falling over the past 5 years, with a -87.7% decrease in ROIC.
valuation_note: FCF yield 1.0%, PEG 1.3, EV/EBITDA 118, P/S 24 — very richly valued — starter position only.
